items.headline: NVIDIA board met overnight on CEO Jensen Huang's future; no outcome announced yet
items.why: CNBC, at 6:06 AM ET, said shares were down about 5% premarket. WSJ reported the board was preparing to remove him. NVIDIA has not confirmed a change.

items.headline: Nebius Q3 revenue is $980.8M; 2026 guide moves to the low end of $3.0-$3.4B
items.why: Official print: $980.8M vs $146.1M a year earlier, $37.5M net loss, adjusted EBITDA $465.8M. 2026 capex rises to about $27B; 2027 revenue is $12-$13B.

items.headline: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B MoE with 14B active, on Qianfan
items.why: 1M context. English post: Apache 2.0 weights coming soon. Chinese post: weights open by 25 Nov. Preview checkpoint; no AA or Epoch score yet.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO site says it expects to price on 18 Nov and trade on 19 Nov
items.why: Per its FAQ, subject to regulatory clearance. Range remains $70 to $78 a share, listing on Nasdaq as ANT.

items.headline: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, trained on more than 100 million cell profiles
items.why: DeepMind says it found nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the prior model on TenK10K (30% vs 16%). Free for non-commercial research.

items.headline: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API, powered by Gemini Decision 1
items.why: Scores up to 1,000 yes/no, choice, or rubric questions on one shared multimodal input. $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with no output-token charge, per Google.

items.headline: Runway releases Praxis-1 open weights under Apache 2.0, including commercial use
items.why: A 27B-parameter world-action model for robots, with weights and code on Hugging Face and GitHub. Runway's RoboLab-120 comparison is a lab claim.

items.headline: Anthropic finds group results worsen when each user has their own agent
items.why: In four simulated shared-resource settings, one agent serving everyone beat a team of per-user agents. Three environments are released as MAMUBench.

items.headline: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 a share, Nasdaq ticker ANT
items.why: 825M Class A shares, 801M of them new from Anthropic. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley lead. Pricing date not on Anthropic's page.

items.headline: Australia to legislate mandatory frontier AI safety rules and a new regulator
items.why: Six duties incl. independent model evals and rapid incident reports, with significant penalties. Bill details still to come.

items.headline: CoreWeave Q3 revenue is $3.66B with a $709M net loss; FY revenue guide rises to $13.0-$13.3B
items.why: Official print: $3.661B revenue vs $1.365B a year earlier, adjusted operating income $379M, backlog about $132.5B. Interest expense was $846M.

items.headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available on the paid Gemini API at $2/$10 through 30 Nov
items.why: API id gemini-4-carbon, 1,048,576-token context. Price steps to $4/$20 on 1 Dec. Not on the free tier. AA High remains 60, behind Fable 5.2 at 65.

items.headline: New York opens a RAISE Act portal for large frontier AI developers
items.why: Register by 1 Jan 2027. From January: safety frameworks, 72-hour incident reports, and model transparency reports. A new state AI safety center also launched.

items.headline: AA launches MKA; Fable 5.2 leads at 57%, Gemini 4 Carbon is #2 at 54%
items.why: 200 visual knowledge-work tasks built with DeepMind. Carbon costs $6.29 per task vs $31.97 for Fable 5.2, per AA.

items.headline: OpenAI starts Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including Business Agents
items.why: Firms can claim a profile and add product feeds. Business Agents start with eligible US ecommerce and online-service businesses.

items.headline: Anthropic adds Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, and generally available Claude Data
items.why: Anthropic says these start today. Its own page still calls Claude Meetings coming soon, narrower than some press reports of a beta.

items.headline: NVIDIA donates OpenShell to CNCF and previews Kubernetes Engine and Snapshot
items.why: Announced at KubeCon. Snapshot design partners report much faster GPU workload restores; those times are partner figures.

items.headline: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2; AA puts Fable 5.2 #1 at 65
items.why: Same model, two access levels. Fable is $8/$40, 20% below 5.1. AA: 65 vs Gemini 4 Carbon High 60; Epoch ECI also tops at 174.

items.headline: Google adds TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max to its eighth-gen TPU lineup
items.why: 8tx keeps data and weights protected in use, up to 2x lower latency than 8t. 8i Max doubles 8i compute, SRAM and HBM bandwidth.

items.headline: Meta's Muse Ember scores 36 on AA Intelligence Index at $0.14 per task
items.why: Matches Claude Haiku 5.5 (max) at about a third of the cost per task, per AA. $0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens on Meta's API.

items.headline: Meituan posts LongCat-2.5 weights under MIT on Hugging Face
items.why: About 1.6T total, 48B active per Meituan. Meituan's own benches put it near older frontier models. No AA Index score yet.

items.headline: OpenAI details Control Room, a system to stop research model workloads fast
items.why: OpenAI says it halts model output within 35 seconds of a stop decision and fails closed if the service goes down.

items.headline: FT: Nvidia tells cloud partners at least 51% of services must go to non-Chinese firms
items.why: Verbal rule for new deals, per FT via Tom's Hardware. Nvidia has not confirmed. Aimed at overseas GPU rentals by Chinese labs.

items.headline: Fireworks AI says attackers reached some customers' datasets and incomplete model weights
items.why: Update to its October incident. Billing data also hit. No impact found on inference, which is zero data retention by default.

items.headline: AA Decision Index v2: decision models top out at 73; Haiku 5.5 Max 77
items.why: Drex Max and GLiDE tie at 73, Mammoth 72. Language models score higher but cost far more per task (Luna Max 76).

items.headline: Sapiens AI's Agnes 2.5 Pro Theta scores 24 on AA Intelligence Index
items.why: Proprietary, 1M context, $0.10/$0.30 per 1M tokens. Released Nov 7; no lab launch post found.

items.headline: FT: Anthropic bought ~$3.4B of gas generators, about 1.7 GW, from OnePWR
items.why: Commitments from late September per FT. Anthropic and OnePWR did not comment.

items.headline: xAI: Grok API text watermarking on by default from Sat 7 Nov
items.why: Covers grok-4.7/4.6/4.5/4.3/4.20 plus tool-call arguments. Team admins can opt out per model.

items.headline: xAI turns on default Grok API text watermarking
items.why: Listed grok-4.x models from Nov 7. Admins can opt out per model; check the x-watermark header.

items.headline: Meta rolls Wonder-trained models into Muse and Meta AI
items.why: Meta's own eval: Active Memory 90% vs 76% on using critical context. Muse Spaces shipped the same day.

items.headline: Nous drops Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B
items.why: Post-trained to cut propaganda-style answers (lab: 22% to about 1%). No AA Index score yet.

items.headline: OpenAI partners with Hacktron and widens its Daybreak Red access
items.why: Joint testing of how OpenAI systems touch third-party services, alongside higher bug bounties.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly closes ~$11B tranche at ~$1.25T valuation
items.why: Bloomberg via TechCrunch. Full round may reach about $20B. OpenAI had not commented.

items.headline: Anthropic publishes agent-memory research on notes and dreaming
items.why: How agents keep notes in session and consolidate memory offline, with Managed Agents case studies.
